name: Loops · User Activity

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 给 SaaS 团队用的邮件平台，营销邮件、生命周期流程和事务性邮件共用一个产品。Workflows 负责触发式序列，Themes 负责让所有邮件继承同一套品牌样式。
description.en: 给 SaaS 团队用的邮件平台，营销邮件、生命周期流程和事务性邮件共用一个产品。Workflows 负责触发式序列，Themes 负责让所有邮件继承同一套品牌样式。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Loops (https://loops.so/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏只有一句 One platform for every email，配 Start for free 和 Explore agents，顶栏导航反常到只剩 ChatGPT、Claude、Codex 三项。紧接着是一段产品实录：左栏 Foldline 项目的 Home / Templates / Campaigns / Workflows / Transactional / Audience / Forms，右栏是 September product launch、Monthly design notes、Onboarding - Free Users、Trial conversion、Password reset 这些条目，各自标着 Draft / Sent / Running / Live，还能看到 Assistant 弹在角落问 Ready when you are.。再往下 Lifecycle workflows that run themselves 配了一张带 Branch 3 branches 和 Audience filter 的流程图，以及 Design every email from one theme 讲 themes 与 components。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
